interface.longDescription: Send and track messages across SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Email, Voice, Viber and Push notifications using your Soprano Connect API account. Also lists approved WhatsApp templates and manages WhatsApp media. Requires an existing Soprano Design Connect API account with the relevant channels provisioned - built for teams already using Soprano Connect who want to trigger messages conversationally instead of through the Connect portal.
capabilities: Send SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Email, Voice, Viber and Push messages
Send broadcast SMS to lists, contacts and groups
Check message and batch delivery status
defaultPrompt: Send a WhatsApp message to +33612345678 letting them know their order has shipped.
